name: observational
title: Observational agent (no input)
description: An agent the user does NOT chat with. The server runs a long task and streams structured progress (steps, logs, done) via SSE; the React component renders a status panel + progress bar. Use for indexing jobs, deployments, model warm-up, anything where the human watches.
nextSteps: Mount the server route in your existing Hono app:
Render the React component somewhere in your route tree:
Replace the STEPS array in server/{{NAME}}-agent.ts with the real steps your task performs.
The component auto-runs on mount; remove the useEffect to require a manual click.
